system.description: You lower your lance and spur forward. While riding, ride up to 40' in a straight line (with no driving test unless the ground is difficult) and make a melee attack (DR12) at the end. It deals an extra d6 damage from the weight of the charge, and the foe cannot make an Opportune Attack against you this turn.

outcomes.failure: Half damage, but you still finish your ride.
outcomes.ruin: Your destrier balks: you stop where you are, and your next driving test this encounter is made with Bane.
